# cJSON

This directory contains `cJSON.c` and `cJSON.h` from
[DaveGamble/cJSON](https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON), pinned to commit
`fb16e5cf358798aabb049655975cde8427101056`.

cJSON is an ANSI C JSON parser and printer distributed under the MIT license.
Pipboy-3000 uses it for versioned player-state save files. The upstream source
files are unmodified; the upstream license is included in this directory.
